gloss: to ruin the atmosphere; to kill the mood

definitions.gloss: to ruin the atmosphere; to kill the mood; to destroy the vibe
definitions.explanation: To say or do something that disrupts the harmonious or positive atmosphere of a social situation. Related to the cultural concept of 'reading the air' (空気を読む).

examples.japanese: {空気|くうき}を{壊|こわ}すようなこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ended up saying something that ruined the mood.

examples.japanese: せっかく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}さないで→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧ほしい。
examples.english: Please don't ruin the fun atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空気|くうき}を{壊|こわ}すような⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He always makes remarks that kill the mood.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧ (air/atmosphere) in Japanese social contexts refers to the unspoken mood, tone, or consensus of a group. {空気|くうき}を{壊|こわ}す means to disrupt this shared atmosphere, often by saying something inappropriate, insensitive, or off-topic.

Related to the well-known expression ⟦{空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む→空気を読む：06306_kuukiwoyomu⟧ (to read the atmosphere), which describes the valued ability to sense the mood and act accordingly. A person who cannot do this is called KY (⟦{空気|くうき}{読|よ}めない→空気読めない：17655_kuukiyomenai⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空気|くうき}を{壊|こわ}す (to ruin the atmosphere of the place)
- {空気|くうき}を{壊|こわ}す⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧ (a mood-killing remark)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む→空気を読む：06306_kuukiwoyomu⟧: to read the room — the ability to sense the mood
- ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{白|しら}けさせる: to dampen the mood — similar meaning, emphasizes awkward silence
